# PATCH /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/branch_protections/{name}

## Response

**200** — api.BranchProtection

- **404** — Branch protection rule not found
- **422** — User or team in whitelist does not exist
- **423** — Repository is archived

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Whitelist users must have write access to the code unit to be added to push/force-push/merge whitelists | authorization | !perm.CanWrite(unit.TypeCode) |
| Approval whitelist users must have at least read access to the pull requests unit | authorization | !prUserIDs.Contains(userID) |
| Disabling push cascades to disable whitelist and deploy keys | business_logic | form.EnablePush != nil && !*form.EnablePush |
| After editing a branch protection, PRs for matching branches are re-checked | business_logic | isBranchExist (plain rule) or glob rule matches branches |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| protectBranch == nil || protectBranch.RepoID != repo.ID | 404 | not found | False |
| Username in whitelist not found | 422 | user does not exist | False |
| Team name in whitelist not found | 422 | team does not exist | False |

### Error Paths

- **Rule not found** → ctx.APIErrorNotFound → 404
- **User not found in whitelist** → ctx.APIError → 422
- **Team not found in whitelist** → ctx.APIError → 422
